facts.fact: Eritel Telecom Corporation's own service page offers paid Eritel Nextcloud private-cloud subscriptions (Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers, 100 to 500 GB, with monthly charges in nakfa and a 90% uptime SLA) that it says are completely hosted in Eritel's Datacenters, so an operator data centre in Eritrea is selling hosting to outside customers; the page names no individual facility and gives no date, so as_of is the page's published date 2026-08-31.
